plugins.name: deep-pr-review
plugins.description: A defect-hunting review pass for one pull request: whole-repo context, the companion repositories that consume the change (web, mobile, export) and the old builds in the field, the stack or epic branch the PR really sits on, a clause-by-clause walk over the repository's own written standards, a hard filter that drops findings without a concrete failure path, and a fixed output contract. Ships its measured hit rate and blind spots.
